facility.label: Our Facility
facility.heading: You deserve to feel confident and strong in your body.
body: At Studio 22 we focus on real, long-term results.

For us, fitness is about community and the commitment to working hard for permanent changes that you can be proud of. Our coaches go through rigorous training to help every member improve their quality of life no matter when they decide to start.

gettingStarted.label: Getting started
gettingStarted.heading: Start today, feel better tomorrow.
gettingStarted.body: We know walking through the door is the hardest part. You take the first step and we’ll meet you where you are.
gettingStarted.note: Most clients begin with an assessment.

image.alt: Two Studio 22 coaches with kettlebells in the gym

steps.title: Lay the foundations
steps.body: Week one is all about laying the foundations. The focus is on quality reps, controlled tempo, and developing confidence in each exercise.

steps.title: Build volume, then strength
steps.body: Week two focuses on building volume and confidence in the movements. Week three marks the shift from building volume to building strength.

steps.title: Realise your strength
steps.body: The Realisation Phase is where all the work comes together. You finish the programme feeling strong, capable and resilient.
